# Rodentia
Rodentia are a race of humanoid beings resembling rodents. Resourceful, evasive, and fragile.
## Benefits
- Uses their claws to do some Slashing and Blunt damage. - Can fit in duffelbags.
## Special
- Can Rummage in disposal chutes, which can sometimes dig up food. - Smaller than most other species.
## Drawbacks
- Takes 15% more Blunt, Slash, and Piercing damage. - Gets hungry 33% faster.
